sections.title: Rate path
sections.text: Policy rate 3.75%-4.00% (held after the 25bp hike on 9/17) · Chair Kevin Warsh leans hawkish: inflation too high, no preset terminal rate

sections.title: Today's focus
sections.text:
Market recap: the 25bp hike on 9/17 to 3.75%-4.00% (unanimous 12:0) was fully priced (92.5% beforehand) and read as dovish — the dot plot suggests at most one more hike this year. On Friday 9/18 risk appetite recovered, led by semis / AI hardware (SOX +3.14%, Arm +8.6%); the S&P fell 0.25% on the week while the Nasdaq rose 0.32%, the 10Y approached 5% (4.996%), the dollar held above 100, and Bitcoin rebounded to $81k.

Sell-side views: Goldman — only one hike, +25bp in total (dovish); BofA — +75bp across Sep/Oct/Dec (most hawkish); Citi — hold until mid-2027, then cut (dovish).
